summary: Iteration 33 — Canonical Bank Filter feature E2E verified. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass in test_bank_filter.py (dedup endpoint returns 'HDFC Bank' only once across HDFC/HDFC BANK/hdfc bank aliases; /banks/registry returns full 10-bank canonical list; finance_bank=HDFC%20Bank filter matches all seeded alias variants; unknown bank passthrough returns 200; Ramya untouched). Frontend: Customer list bank filter dropdown shows 6 deduped canonical names (HDFC Bank, Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, State Bank of India, TATA Capital — single HDFC entry); selecting HDFC Bank filters 8 customers and aggregates ₹32,04,347 Total Overdue across aliases. BookingDetailsCard edit form Select shows all 10 canonical banks + 'Other (type below)' option; selecting Other reveals the text Input for legacy/free-text values. PaymentStep.jsx (public booking form) source-verified to use CANONICAL_BANKS in a Select with no free-text Input — wizard requires walking multiple steps to render but the component code is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/utils/banks.py — clean canonical/alias registry. _norm collapses whitespace + lowercases. to_canonical returns the input.strip() unchanged for unknown banks so they still appear in the filter list (good UX).
backend/customers/routes.py:97-105 — finance_bank filter builds a case-insensitive regex anchored with ^...$ from all aliases. Correct and SQL-injection-safe via re.escape().
customer create endpoint requires 'tower' field — not part of this story but documented for next testing agent (test_bank_filter.py adds tower='Tower A' to TEST seed payloads).
frontend/src/utils/banks.js mirrors backend canonical list — keep these two in sync; consider a single source served from /banks/registry to avoid drift.

BookingDetailsCard.jsx:55 — Select value coercion: if current finance_bank is not in CANONICAL_BANKS, defaults the Select to '__other__' and pre-fills the Input with the legacy value. Verified working with empty/'-' state. Good legacy-data handling.
PaymentStep.jsx — Preferred Bank Select has no free-text Other option (per spec, public form should be locked to canonical names). Field is conditionally rendered when finance_type !== 'self'.
CustomerFilters.jsx:35-45 — bank dropdown is fed from /api/customers/banks (deduped) — good.

MINOR: backend /banks endpoint still passes through unknown banks unchanged (line 48 of utils/banks.py returns raw.strip()), so if anyone enters 'hdfc bank ' with a trailing space it would not collapse with 'HDFC Bank' — but _norm handles trailing spaces via .strip() so this is actually fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on Customers list filter + BookingDetailsCard edit + PaymentStep code review

seed_data_creation: Inserted 3 _TEST_BankFilter_* customers with finance_bank values 'HDFC', 'HDFC BANK', 'hdfc bank' via pytest module fixture; auto-deleted in teardown. Ramya's finance_bank was NOT modified at any point (Cancel was clicked in the edit dialog).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 33 canonical-bank filter feature works end-to-end. Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_bank_filter.py (6/6). Customer create POST requires `tower` field — keep in mind for any future seed payloads. PaymentStep was not exercised through full wizard UI flow (multi-step form requires extensive fixture data) but source confirmed to use CANONICAL_BANKS Select with no free-text. No open bugs from this story.
